correctness.rationale: Harmonicity follows by explicit Laplacian of the quartic zonal polynomial in ambient dimension n-1. The addition theorem fixes sampling normalization. Complete-graph unsigned incidence diagonalizes all N-by-N Gram matrices into exactly three Johnson sectors with fully verified multiplicities; the displayed positive rational eigenvalues establish surjectivity. Exact pairwise subtraction establishes all sector transitions and every equiangular dimension, and exact rational difference signs plus monotonicity prove the uniform 7/32 and 11/35 lower bounds. Standalone exact Fraction checker passed 4<=n<=25 recurrence/trace checks and 4<=n<=12 direct full-matrix eigenspace checks; finite checks are supplementary, not the all-n proof. Domain: n integer >=4 and exact degree 4; no coefficient injectivity claim.

General sampling rates or harmonic-index design Fisher bounds do not yield these concrete equalities.

originality.rationale: Bounded explicit statement-and-implication comparisons found fixed-rank A4 and A5 quartic spectra, an all-rank odd-degree A-root theorem, and a quartic type-D-root theorem; none implies the complete all-rank even-quartic spectrum with three equiangular dimensions and the 209-dimensional coalescence at n=21. Multiple complete accessible full texts and published summaries were examined. Unindexed equivalent tabulations remain a residual priority risk; absence of search results is not a proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not independently established; an unindexed older association-scheme table may contain equivalent formulas.

Potential implicit coverage by stronger unexamined fixed-orbit or general Gegenbauer formulas remains a priority risk; derivability from classical tools is not by itself a publication-priority determination.
The type-D quartic and simplex-edge-midpoint published records were consulted by summary only; their title/object distinction was not used as a full-text negative check.

value.rationale: Determines sharp and dimension-uniform interpolation stability for a canonical all-rank high-symmetry root orbit, with an exact bottleneck transition, not merely a low-rank numerical table. The equiangular kernel embedding has a geometrically intrinsic two-off-diagonal-class motivation, completely classifies when the classes collapse in absolute value, and exposes the 210-point dimension-21 example with a 209-fold spectral eigenspace; these exact classes can inform harmonic interpolation and orbit-design comparisons. No claim is made about optimal packing, unrelated source bands or reconstructing all harmonic coefficients.
